proof_body:
by
  intro f hf
  filter_upwards [IsUnifLocDoublingMeasure.ae_tendsto_average MeasureTheory.volume hf 1] with x hx
  refine hx (fun _ => x) (fun r => r) Filter.tendsto_id ?_
  filter_upwards [self_mem_nhdsWithin] with r hr
  rw [one_mul]
  exact Metric.mem_closedBall_self (le_of_lt hr)
target_source: ∀ (f : ℝ → ℝ), MeasureTheory.LocallyIntegrable f MeasureTheory.volume → ∀ᵐ x ∂(MeasureTheory.volume : MeasureTheory.Measure ℝ), Filter.Tendsto (fun r : ℝ => MeasureTheory.average (MeasureTheory.volume.restrict (Metric.closedBall x r)) f) (nhdsWithin 0 (Set.Ioi 0)) (nhds (f x))
